Incomplete Knowledge Graph Traversal.hddl_text:
(define (domain graph_traversal)
 (:requirements :typing :hierarchy)
 
 (:types
 node edge - object
 )
 
 (:predicates (current-node ?n - node)
 (edge-exists ?from - node ?to - node)
 (weight-known ?from - node ?to - node)
 (weight-defined ?from - node ?to - node)
 (path-passes-through ?n - node)
 (visited ?n - node)
 )
 
 (:task find-shortest-path :parameters (?start - node ?end - node ?pass-through - node)
 )
 
 (:method find-shortest-path-with-research :parameters (?start - node ?end - node ?pass-through - node ?from - node ?to - node)
 :task (find-shortest-path ?start ?end ?pass-through)
 :precondition (and
 (current-node ?start)
 (edge-exists ?from ?to)
 (not (weight-known ?from ?to))
 )
 :subtasks (and
 (t1 (research ?from ?to))
 (t2 (find-shortest-path ?start ?end ?pass-through))
 )
 :ordering (t1 < t2)
 )
 
 (:method find-shortest-path-without-research :parameters (?start - node ?end - node ?pass-through - node)
 :task (find-shortest-path ?start ?end ?pass-through)
 :precondition (and
 (current-node ?start)
 (path-passes-through ?pass-through)
 )
 :subtasks (and
 (t1 (move ?start ?pass-through))
 (t2 (move ?pass-through ?end))
 )
 :ordering (t1 < t2)
 )
 
 (:action research :parameters (?from - node ?to - node)
 :precondition (and
 (edge-exists ?from ?to)
 (not (weight-known ?from ?to))
 )
 :effect (weight-known ?from ?to)
 )
 
 (:action move :parameters (?from - node ?to - node)
 :precondition (and
 (current-node ?from)
 (edge-exists ?from ?to)
 (weight-known ?from ?to)
 )
 :effect (and
 (current-node ?to)
 (not (current-node ?from))
 (visited ?from)
 )
 )
)
preconditions: Unknown weights must be discovered before use

Constrained Tower of Hanoi.hddl_text:
(define (domain tower_of_hanoi)
 (:requirements :typing :hierarchy)
 
 (:types
 peg disk - object
 )
 
 (:predicates (on-peg ?d - disk ?p - peg)
 (on-disk ?d1 - disk ?d2 - disk)
 (empty-peg ?p - peg)
 (fragile-peg ?p - peg)
 (clear-disk ?d - disk)
 (goal-state ?p - peg)
 )
 
 (:task move-disk :parameters (?d - disk ?from - peg ?to - peg)
 )
 
 (:task solve-tower :parameters (?p - peg)
 )
 
 (:method solve-tower-method :parameters (?p - peg)
 :task (solve-tower ?p)
 :precondition (goal-state ?p)
 :subtasks ()
 )
 
 (:method move-disk-method :parameters (?d - disk ?from - peg ?to - peg)
 :task (move-disk ?d ?from ?to)
 :precondition (and (on-peg ?d ?from) (empty-peg ?to) (clear-disk ?d))
 :subtasks (and
 (t1 (pick ?d ?from))
 (t2 (place ?d ?to))
 )
 :ordering (t1 < t2)
 )
 
 (:action pick :parameters (?d - disk ?p - peg)
 :precondition (and (on-peg ?d ?p) (clear-disk ?d))
 :effect (not (on-peg ?d ?p))
 )
 
 (:action place :parameters (?d - disk ?p - peg)
 :precondition (and (not (on-peg ?d ?p)) (empty-peg ?p))
 :effect (and (on-peg ?d ?p) (not (empty-peg ?p)))
 )
 
 (:action move :parameters (?d - disk ?from - peg ?to - peg)
 :precondition (and (on-peg ?d ?from) (empty-peg ?to) (clear-disk ?d) (not (fragile-peg ?to)))
 :effect (and (on-peg ?d ?to) (not (on-peg ?d ?from)) (not (empty-peg ?to)))
 )
)
preconditions: Larger disk cannot be on smaller disk
Disk 3 cannot be placed on Peg B (fragile peg)
Only one disk can be moved at a time

Probabilistic Graph Traversal.hddl_text:
(define (domain probabilistic_planning)
 (:requirements :typing :hierarchy)
 
 (:types
 node edge - object
 )
 
 (:predicates (current-node ?n - node)
 (edge-known ?from - node ?to - node)
 (time-elapsed ?t - node)
 (path-chosen ?p - node)
 (safe-route ?n - node)
 (risky-route ?n - node)
 (base-time-known ?e - edge)
 (penalty-known ?e - edge)
 (penalty-probability-known ?e - edge)
 (expected-time-known ?e - edge)
 (goal-reached ?n - node)
 )
 
 (:task reach-goal :parameters (?n - node)
 )
 
 (:method choose-safe-route :parameters (?n - node)
 :task (reach-goal ?n)
 :precondition (and (current-node ?n) (safe-route ?n))
 :subtasks (and
 (t1 (move-to-A ?n))
 (t2 (move-to-End ?n))
 )
 :ordering (t1 < t2)
 )
 
 (:method choose-risky-route :parameters (?n - node)
 :task (reach-goal ?n)
 :precondition (and (current-node ?n) (risky-route ?n))
 :subtasks (and
 (t1 (move-to-B ?n))
 (t2 (move-to-End ?n))
 )
 :ordering (t1 < t2)
 )
 
 (:action move-to-A :parameters (?n - node)
 :precondition (and (current-node ?n) (edge-known ?n A))
 :effect (and (current-node A) (time-elapsed A))
 )
 
 (:action move-to-B :parameters (?n - node)
 :precondition (and (current-node ?n) (edge-known ?n B))
 :effect (and (current-node B) (time-elapsed B))
 )
 
 (:action move-to-End :parameters (?n - node)
 :precondition (and (current-node ?n) (edge-known ?n End))
 :effect (and (current-node End) (goal-reached End))
 )
)
preconditions: Cannot turn back once path is chosen
Must choose between Safe and Risky paths
Goal is to minimize expected total time
subtasks: apply_strategy(Compare the expected total time of each path and choose the one with the lowest value)

Multi-Resource Task Scheduling.hddl_text:
(define (domain resource_scheduling)
 (:requirements :typing :hierarchy)
 
 (:types
 task resource - object
 )
 
 (:predicates (task-defined ?t - task)
 (resource-defined ?r - resource)
 (cpu-allocated ?t - task)
 (memory-allocated ?t - task)
 (gpu-allocated ?t - task)
 (task-scheduled ?t - task)
 (task-completed ?t - task)
 (dependency-met ?t1 - task ?t2 - task)
 (high-priority ?t - task)
 (medium-priority ?t - task)
 (low-priority ?t - task)
 (time-defined)
 (resources-defined)
 )
 
 (:task schedule-task :parameters (?t - task)
 )
 
 (:method schedule-by-priority :parameters (?t - task)
 :task (schedule-task ?t)
 :precondition (and
 (task-defined ?t)
 (resources-defined)
 )
 :subtasks (and
 (t1 (allocate-cpu ?t))
 (t2 (allocate-memory ?t))
 (t3 (allocate-gpu ?t))
 )
 :ordering (and (t1 < t2) (t2 < t3))
 )
 
 (:method allocate-resources :parameters (?t - task)
 :task (schedule-task ?t)
 :precondition (task-defined ?t)
 :subtasks (and
 (t1 (allocate-cpu ?t))
 (t2 (allocate-memory ?t))
 (t3 (allocate-gpu ?t))
 )
 :ordering (and (t1 < t2) (t2 < t3))
 )
 
 (:action allocate-cpu :parameters (?t - task)
 :precondition (and
 (task-defined ?t)
 (resources-defined)
 )
 :effect (cpu-allocated ?t)
 )
 
 (:action allocate-memory :parameters (?t - task)
 :precondition (and
 (task-defined ?t)
 (resources-defined)
 )
 :effect (memory-allocated ?t)
 )
 
 (:action allocate-gpu :parameters (?t - task)
 :precondition (and
 (task-defined ?t)
 (resources-defined)
 )
 :effect (gpu-allocated ?t)
 )
 
 (:action schedule-task-action :parameters (?t - task)
 :precondition (and
 (task-defined ?t)
 (cpu-allocated ?t)
 (memory-allocated ?t)
 (gpu-allocated ?t)
 )
 :effect (task-scheduled ?t)
 )
 
 (:action complete-task :parameters (?t - task)
 :precondition (task-scheduled ?t)
 :effect (task-completed ?t)
 )
)
preconditions: Dependencies must complete before dependent task starts
High priority tasks should be scheduled first when possible
